title_zh: 选定柔和色调的肖像画作为礼物

scenario.label_zh: 选定柔和色调的肖像画作为礼物
scenario.goal_zh: 比较两幅肖像的色调和笔触，并选定柔和版本送给母亲

context_zh: 画廊访客与朋友比较同一人物的两幅肖像版画。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: The red version is striking. You notice it as soon as you enter the room.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: It is, but your mother's room is quite restful. Look at the softer tone of this blue one.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: I love the way one stroke of the brush suggests the whole shoulder. Is that detail in both versions?

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Yes. They're prints from the same drawing, with different colours added.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: The red one is stunning on this wall, but I think Mum would live more happily with the blue one.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Then choose the blue. A present doesn't have to be the boldest thing in the gallery.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: You're right. That's the one I'll ask the assistant for.
